★★★★★ Amazing food, unique dishes
Sep 2026 • Family
Had a fantastic meal at KOTO Hanoi every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The betel leaf prawn was a highlight: fresh prawns with crispy shallots, herbs, edible flowers and shaved carrot, so unique and full of texture. For dessert, the caramelized banana flambé with ice cream was warm, rich, and perfectly balanced.

Beyond the food, KOTO is a social enterprise training disadvantaged youth in hospitality, so you're supporting a great cause while enjoying a great meal. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Hanoi!
Read more
Written September 19, 2026
KOTO Van Mieu
Dear Hozyr, 

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the flavors, presentation, and unique textures of our dishes, especially the betel leaf prawn and caramelized banana flambé. It means a lot to know you had such a memorable experience at KOTO Van Mieu. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back again soon!

Warm regards,
KOTO Van Mieu Team 💚
